name: Atticus MCP Server Tools Specification
description: JSON specification defining the available tools, parameters, and return shapes supported by the Atticus Model Context Protocol (MCP) server.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: Lists all configured AI providers and models in Atticus, showing which instances are enabled and currently have active API keys configured. No raw apiKeys are returned.

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.description: Provides secure AI chat completions using Atticus configured credentials and audit compliance logs. No raw API keys are exposed to the calling environment.

providerId.description: The custom provider ID from list_providers to route this chat message through.

content.description: The text content of the message.

temperature.description: Creative diversity level of response (e.g., 0.0 to 1.0).

tools.name: srais_scan
tools.description: Performs a multilingual SRAIS scan on target document text or message content to identify potential legal, regulatory, breach of contract, or financial misconduct risks.

text.description: The narrative text or draft document to scan for risk.

tools.name: pii_scan
tools.description: Runs local pattern-matching for Personally Identifiable Information (PII) including SSNs, financial IDs, and general credentials.

text.description: The message or document text to scan.

tools.name: list_conversations
tools.description: Lists all stored local conversations in Atticus directory, returning metadata including message counts and final timestamp.

tools.name: load_conversation
tools.description: Loads details and chat history of a specific saved conversation by its ID.

tools.name: save_conversation
tools.description: Saves or updates a conversation record locally in the Atticus data footprint.

conversation.description: The complete conversation object structure to be written.

messages.description: The list of conversation message objects.

tools.name: extract_document_text
tools.description: Extracts raw text content from local PDF, DOCX, or Excel files utilizing Atticus' internal secure extraction engines.

filePath.description: The absolute local file path to the target document.

tools.name: get_audit_logs
tools.description: Retrieves internal Atticus compliance and privacy audit logs for analyzing historical actions or security events.

limit.description: The maximum number of recent audit events to return.
